summary: The base implementation makes EAGLE draft graph/eager selection depend on rank-local DSA seed availability, reproducing the original asymmetric-path mechanism. The candidate makes the decision rank-independent for precisely PD decode, attention DP greater than one, and DSA draft-extend seed sharing by forcing all affected ranks to eager execution. Independent idle/non-idle and boundary tests passed. Eager ModelRunner execution applies DP/MLP synchronization padding from globally shared token counts; for the reported one-active/seven-idle shape it selects SUM_LEN with an identical shared buffer length on every rank. This is a source-level full fix for the reported deadlock mechanism, though the exact 8x B30Z GLM-5.2 deployment could not be run on the assigned single gfx950 GPU.

tests.what_was_measured: On the recorded base, three subtests confirm graph replay with a present seed but eager execution with a missing seed, directly reproducing the rank-local branch divergence behind the issue.
At exact candidate commit 907c7dc1e99455a48716e31730101aad1e2e08e7, 9 tests and 10 subtests passed, including the candidate regression and adjacent EAGLE behavior.
At the exact candidate, 37 tests and 12 subtests passed for adjacent PD-disaggregation metadata and wire behavior.

Eight independent review cases explicitly exercised both idle and non-idle affected ranks, seed present/absent, non-PD mode, DP=1, seed-sharing disabled, and an already-eager decision. All affected ranks selected eager while unrelated configurations retained prior behavior.

The changed Python source compiled successfully at the exact candidate commit.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) executed the independent DP-count tensor check. The original eight-rank NCCL deadlock was not run because only one GPU was assigned.

remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) was assigned; the reported environment used eight B30Z Blackwell GPUs, so the original NCCL hang and post-fix completion were not reproduced end-to-end.
The zai-org/GLM-5.2-FP8 weights and a full speculative PD prefill/decode deployment were unavailable; model semantic accuracy and production performance remain unmeasured.
The candidate intentionally disables draft CUDA graphs for the affected configuration. Correctness is supported by eager DP padding behavior, but the performance cost was not benchmarked.
No C++ or FlyDSL/native source changed, repository-environment.json records native as null, and imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang; no native rebuild was applicable.
